tooltip.frontierhunts.rowboat.1: An old lapstrake rowboat. Seats two.
tooltip.frontierhunts.rowboat.2: W rows both oars, A / D pulls one and backs the other, S backs water.
tooltip.frontierhunts.jon_boat.1: Aluminium jon boat with a tiller outboard. Seats two.
tooltip.frontierhunts.jon_boat.2: Runs on gas: use a Jerry Can on the boat to fill the tank. Sneak + use opens the dry box.
message.frontierhunts.boat_no_gas: The tank is empty. You can paddle slowly, or use a Jerry Can on the boat to fill it.
message.frontierhunts.boat_out_of_gas: The motor sputters and dies. Out of gas.
